movie.title: Toy Story 2
movie.overview: Andy heads off to Cowboy Camp, leaving his toys to their own devices. Things shift into high gear when an obsessive toy collector named Al McWhiggen, owner of Al's Toy Barn kidnaps Woody. Andy's toys mount a daring rescue mission, Buzz Lightyear meets his match and Woody has to decide where he and his heart truly belong.

facts: This movie holds a special place as the last Toy Story film to feature the iconic Jim Varney as the voice of Slinky Dog. He sadly passed away the following year, making this his final appearance in the series.
Did you know that four talented writers were credited for the Toy Story 2 screenplay? Andrew Stanton, Rita Hsiao, Doug Chamberlin, and Chris Webb all helped craft this beloved sequel!

Beyond just being kidnapped, Woody faces a deeper temptation in the film: the allure of immortality in a museum after meeting Jessie and other toys from his franchise. Talk about a complex choice for our favorite cowboy!
